premises: On a quasi-embedded Euclidean polyhedral space, let Π carry continuous real piecewise-affine functions f,g and a real k-dimensional weight c on an open set U. The BBGS negative inward-unit-normal product commutes with restriction and subdivision; for k≥2, f·(g·c)=g·(f·c). If c is a Minkowski weight, its restrictions, subdivision pullbacks and defined piecewise-affine products are Minkowski weights. Positivity of c is not required. These are BBGS, Math. Z. 301 (2022), Propositions 3.12, 3.15 and 3.19 with Lemma 3.18.

In the literal rational setup of BMPS arXiv:2603.08664v1, the primitive tangent-corrected divisor of a piecewise-affine function and a balanced rational cycle commutes with rational refinement (Lemma 2.34). On a finite pure-dimensional balanced rational space, bounded differences of piecewise-affine functions preserve raw degree (Lemma 4.6). For literal piecewise-affine f₀,…,f_d, if f_i and f_k are bounded, then ∫_X f_i MA_poly(f₀,…,f̂_i,…,f_d)=∫_X f_k MA_poly(f₀,…,f̂_k,…,f_d) (Lemma 4.9).
